A photographer with a professional camera lens appears in the lower-left corner of the frame, capturing her movements. (4) A young man in a white and blue baseball uniform briefly enters the frame, performing a quick synchronized dance move before walking off. The woman continues her routine, facing the crowd and leading the cheering with the microphone.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy EDM background music begins immediately with a heavy, syncopated beat. A female voice shouts rhythmic cheering slogans into a microphone with high arousal and a clear, piercing tone. (2) The female voice continues leading a call-and-response chant. Background crowd noise consisting of muffled cheering and rhythmic clapping is audible. A sharp electronic whoosh sound effect signals a transition. (3) A male voice with professional broadcasting resonance briefly announces a player's name over the stadium PA system. The BGM dips slightly in volume then swells back as the female speaker resumes her energetic chanting. (4) The music shifts to a new melodic phrase, maintaining the fast tempo. The female speaker’s pitch remains high and consistent, matching the percussive drive of the synthesizer track. (5) A quick percussive impact SFX occurs as the video cuts to a new angle. The mix features continuous overlap between the loud, bright BGM and the enunciated speech of the lead speaker.
